estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands stripping the leaves from a straight young fig branch to leave about 30 cm of clean stem
Close-up of a man's hands using a small knife to remove a narrow ring of bark around a fig branch with two shallow cuts

Close-up of a man's hands wrapping damp moss around the cut on a fig branch inside black plastic, tying it with string below and above; the small mascot figurine sits on the branch just above the wrap
Seedling tray with several young seedlings fallen over, each with a brown shriveled ring at the base of the stem, damp soil
A low jasmine branch laid along the ground and pinned into the soil at several points with U-shaped wire
A clump of a leafy perennial plant divided into several rooted pieces lying on soil next to a garden fork; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil beside the pieces
An African violet leaf with its stalk pushed into a small pot of moist soil, tiny new leaves sprouting at the base
Saxifraga stolonifera mother plant with a runner plantlet pinned into the soil of a small pot placed next to it
Close-up of a man's hands cutting an 8 to 10 cm tip cutting from a flowering impatiens plant with small pruning shears
Close-up of a man's hands pushing an impatiens tip cutting into a small pot of peat mixed with coarse sand; the small mascot figurine sits on the rim of the pot
Close-up of a man's hands placing a small pot with an impatiens cutting in a bright corner away from strong direct sun
Young impatiens seedlings collapsed and fallen over at the base of the stem in a small pot of damp soil
Snapdragon with tall spikes of pink, yellow and white flowers in a sunny garden bed
Gomphrena globosa with round purple and pink flower heads in a sunny garden bed
Sweet alyssum with tiny white flowers forming a low carpet along the edge of a garden bed; the small mascot figurine stands on the garden path next to it
Nigella damascena with pale blue flowers and inflated striped seed pods among feathery leaves
Close-up of a man's hands pressing a cucumber seed 2 cm deep into a small mound of rich soil in a large pot
Close-up of a man's hands tying three bamboo canes together at the top to form a tepee over a large pot with a young cucumber plant; the small mascot figurine sits on the rim of the pot
Close-up of a man's hands winding garden twine from the bottom up around a bamboo cane so a young cucumber vine can climb it
